content.title: Justin Bieber Chooses Billie Eilish as His "One Less Lonely Girl" at Coachella
content.text: Billie Eilish Tears Up During Justin Bieber's Surprise "One Less Lonely Girl" Performance at Coachella The friends first met at Coachella in 2019. 0 seconds of 37 secondsVolume 0% Did You Notice These Taylor Swift Easter Eggs in TSITP? Billie Eilish smiles as she stands in the audience at Justin Bieber's Coachella weekend two closing set on April 18, 2026. Credit: Getty Images Billie Eilish teared up when Justin Bieber pulled her on stage for a performance of "One Less Lonely Girl" on April 18.The performance was part of Bieber's closing set at Coachella weekend two.Eilish, a lifelong "Belieber," and Bieber first met at Coachella in April 2019 and have been friends ever since. Billie Eilish had a full-circle moment at Coachella on Saturday. During Justin Bieber's headlining set on April 18, Eilish experienced every "Belieber's" dream come true when he pulled her on stage for his performance of "One Less Lonely Girl." From the front row, where she'd been enjoying the show, Eilish already began to get emotional, covering her mouth in disbelief. In a clip shared by Entertainment Tonight, Eilish, 24, couldn't contain her excitement as she joined Bieber, 32, on stage. As Bieber sang the chorus, Eilish covered her face with both hands, clearly reeling from the unexpected moment. Just as the song came to a close, the "Happier Than Ever" singer fell to her knees, overcome with joy. Related Stories Bieber wasted no time pulling Eilish into a hug and giving her a kiss on the back of the head as they stood up together. The friends shared one more tight embrace before Eilish ran to rejoin the crowd. The moment was especially meaningful for Eilish, a Bieber superfan, who met the "Daisies" singer at her first Coachella in 2019, when she was 17 years old. Since their first encounter, the singers have remained close friends, with Bieber taking on a protective role over Eilish in the music industry. Billie Eilish gets emotional as she stands in the audience at Justin Bieber's Coachella weekend two closing set on April 18, 2026. Getty Images "I just want to protect her," Bieber said in an interview with Beats 1's Zane Lowe in February 2020. "I don't want her to lose it. I don't want her to go through anything I went through. I don't wish that upon anybody. If she ever needs me I'm just a call away." Eilish spoke to Bieber's supportive role in her life in an interview on SiriusXM Hits 1's Morning Mash Up. "He's a good friend of mine," she said. "He, you know, has been so helpful for me, in terms of just, like, dealing with fame. And he'll call me sometimes and just say stuff that makes me just feel heard, and like there's somebody else that goes through the same stuff. So it's really nice to have him." Justin Bieber, Billie Eilish, and Hailey Bieber attend the 68th Grammy Awards in Los Angeles on February 1, 2026. Getty Images Bieber was the final headlining act for Coachella weekend two, closing out the festival with a bang. In addition to Eilish's unplanned guest appearance, Bieber welcomed several fellow singer on stage during both weekends of the festival. Notable guests included The Kid LAROI, Dijon, Tems, Wizkid, Mk.gee, SZA, Sexxy Red, and Big Sean. Justin Bieber and Sexxy Red perform on the Coachella stage in Indio, California on April 18, 2026.
